name: Standard (Default)
description: Balanced brightness and contrast for general web browsing and daily desktop work.

name: Gaming
description: High brightness and elevated contrast to enhance detail and visibility in dark corners during gameplay.

name: Movie
description: Lower brightness with rich contrast for comfortable video viewing in dimly lit rooms.

name: Reading
description: Ultra-low brightness and relaxed contrast to reduce eye strain when reading long articles or documents.

name: Night
description: Minimal brightness and lower contrast to prevent harsh glare during late-night desktop sessions.

name: Vivid
description: Maxed-out brightness and strong contrast to make photos, graphics, and colorful media pop.

name: Bright
description: Maximum brightness and contrast for the brightest possible display image.
